events.description: A physical confrontation occurs between two players: the player in blue jersey #0 (Golden State Warriors) and the player in white jersey #46 (Boston Celtics). At f5 (34.5s), they are engaged in close contact; by f6–f7 (35.0–35.5s), the Celtics player #46 appears to push or shove the Warriors player #0, who then loses balance and falls backward. The interaction involves mutual physical engagement and forceful contact, meeting the definition of fighting.

After the fall at f8 (36.0s), the Celtics player #46 is on the floor, clearly helpless. Multiple Warriors players (including #0 and #4) step over or near him without assisting, and one (possibly #0) appears to make incidental but avoidable contact with his head/shoulder area while moving past (f9–f12). Though not a deliberate strike, the repeated proximity and lack of avoidance while the opponent is down constitutes abuse of a helpless victim per the defined category.

A physical altercation erupts between players from opposing teams (Golden State Warriors and Boston Celtics), involving shoving, grabbing, and escalation into a multi-player scuffle, with referees intervening to separate them.
A physical altercation erupts between players from opposing teams near the sideline, involving shoving, grabbing, and aggressive posturing; multiple referees and players intervene to separate them.

The initial fight escalates into a multi-person scuffle involving at least six players and two referees, with chaotic movement, pushing, and attempts to restrain individuals—constituting collective violent unrest on the court.

A separate, later-onset physical confrontation occurs near the baseline where a Celtics player (No. 46) shoves a Warriors player (No. 0), who then retaliates with a push; both are actively engaged in mutual combat.
Multiple players from both teams engage in a physical altercation near the sideline, with pushing, grabbing, and attempts to separate; referees intervene to break up the scuffle.
A player in white (Celtics #46) appears to strike or elbow a fallen player in blue (Warriors #20) while the latter is on the ground, constituting an attack on a helpless victim.

Three players engage in mutual physical combat under the basket: player #0 (purple jersey) shoves and swings at player #0 (white jersey), who retaliates with a punch; player #25 (white jersey) joins by grabbing and pushing player #0 (purple), while player #12 (white jersey) is on the ground and involved in the scuffle. The exchange includes multiple punches, grabs, and shoves among all three standing players.

Player #12 (white jersey, number 12) is on the floor, appearing helpless, while being struck and pushed by standing players (#0 purple and #0 white), constituting abuse of a downed opponent during the ongoing fight.

A multi-player physical altercation erupts under the basket, beginning with a shove between two players (No. 0 in white and No. 0 in blue) at 92.0s, escalating to mutual pushing, grabbing, and shoving involving at least five players by 97.0s, with referees intervening from 96.5s onward.
Multiple players from opposing teams engage in a physical altercation near the basket, involving pushing, grabbing, and shoving; referees intervene to separate them.
